summary: All four r1 findings verified resolved at the code: the py_compile artifact is gone from the synced tree (find + git status --ignored both clean), the iac-prune comment now cites the docker run --pull=always that bin/iac:40,63 actually runs, both spec pointers resolve to files present on AnsibleSpecs origin/main, and the install.sh hint is location-agnostic again. The fix commit introduces no behaviour change and interacts correctly with install.sh (no unit change, so no daemon-reload or agent restart), and the plan's amended R6 parity rule matches the five files the branch actually edits. Two Minor advisories only: bin/iac-impl:6 keeps a section anchor that commit 648d922 deleted from the file it now correctly points at, and plan.md:411-413's done-record bullet still describes the pre-fix error text.
